Hairline

Tactical FPS framework. 128-tick authoritative sim, client prediction, stylized lighting and authored models, deterministic spray patterns. Flagship map: Dockside 9.

Clear the map of hostiles or plant the spike on A or B before the clock runs out. Dummies in spawn strafe for warm-up.

Hairline needs a keyboard and mouse. You can still browse loadouts and settings here.
